pairs.registryProposal: resolution-precondition covers 'publishing an order over models or prompts or configurations' only for eval matrix runs. It says nothing about a production telemetry leaderboard that sorts agents by a composite with no noise check, and here the engine's only guard is MIN_RUNS=3 on the delta (src/lib/standings.ts). That case could be named in scoring-rubrics, or in a technique's boundary, so seats don't stretch resolution-precondition onto it.
